result.summary: Found 2 major visual issues: low-contrast promotional text that is hard to read, and a restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section that is partially cut off by the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: Promo banner subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' has very low contrast against the light mint-green background and is barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or a slightly darker shade of green for the banner background to meet contrast ratio guidelines and improve readability.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' list (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom by the bottom navigation bar, making it appear broken.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or margin below the last card so the full card is visible above the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list, so the full name is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card width to accommodate the full name, show it on two lines, or use a smaller font size for long restaurant names.
